findings.description: No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so objects stored in this bucket are not encrypted at rest by default.

findings.issue_category: no bucket ACL / public access controls
findings.description: No acl attribute is set and no aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block is configured for this bucket, leaving it potentially subject to default or overly permissive access settings without explicit restriction.
This bucket stores ledger/financial export data but has no server_side_encryption_configuration, leaving sensitive financial data unencrypted at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this bucket, so model artifacts are stored unencrypted.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined, so operational runbook data (potentially containing sensitive operational details) is stored unencrypted.

The object is uploaded to a bucket without server-side encryption configured and without specifying kms_key_id or server_side_encryption on the object itself, so the vendor roster file is stored in cleartext.
